# openrouter_observability_destination (Data Source)

ObservabilityDestination DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openrouter_observability_destination" "my_observabilitydestination" {
  id = "99999999-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddddddddddd"
}
```
